t2.thesis: Zeta brings an unbroken string of beat-and-raise prints (20 consecutive quarters) and a perfect 4-for-4 post-earnings open win rate into an earnings release following mild recent share price consolidation.
reasons: Consistent historical performance: 4 of the last 4 earnings prints generated positive open-to-open returns ranging from +6.2% to +12.5% with double-digit EPS surprises.
Strong operating momentum with 43.5% revenue growth, positive GAAP net income inflection, and positive institutional backing (recent Goldman Sachs upgrade).
The stock has pulled back ~6% over the past month and sits 9% off its 52-week high, easing short-term bar-clearing pressure ahead of the print.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 and full-year 2026 guidance raise magnitude, particularly organic revenue growth and AI/Athena enterprise customer adoption trajectory.

prior.from: software_internet cluster base rate (0.541) and AMC base rate (0.538)

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up from 0.54 to 0.61 (+0.07) driven by the company's flawless 4/4 reaction win rate, sustained 40%+ revenue growth profile, and constructive positioning into the release.

theses.expected: ZETA posts another substantial revenue and EPS beat and raises full-year guidance above consensus.
theses.mechanism: Enterprise customer expansion (Super-Scaled customer ARPU up 17%) and AI platform monetization drive accelerated revenue upside, forcing momentum buyers and short covering.
theses.wrong_if: Management guides Q4 conservatively or political/ad spend normalization reveals a deceleration in organic baseline revenue growth.

theses.expected: High implied move (15.6%) leads to strong gap up if top-line beats comfortably.
theses.mechanism: A 1.4 average analyst rating and healthy call skew facilitate a bullish pre-market opening auction.
theses.wrong_if: Broader software/tech sentiment sours or operating expenses from R&D and AthenaOS rollout pressure margin expectations.

theses.expected: Stock rallies initially on headline metrics at the open.
theses.mechanism: First reaction auction responds directly to another consecutive beat-and-raise headline.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance commentary highlights macro elongation of enterprise sales cycles or budget pushbacks.

key_observations: Full-year 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance adjustments
Super-Scaled customer count and ARPU metrics
Net income and Free Cash Flow generation progression
